title: Raw abelian stage Kan-extension diagram and compatible comparison
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of abelian groups. Give $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^sH$ whose composites with the stage units equal the unit for $V_i$ componentwise as arrow objects. There exist an abelian presheaf diagram $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C,\mathrm{Ab})$, morphisms $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$, and a natural transformation $\gamma:B\to\mathrm{const}(H)$ with the following properties. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$ and $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction. Each $\beta_t$ is a universal left Kan unit: composition with it bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every abelian presheaf $T$. For all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$. Finally $\beta_t(X)\gamma_t(V_tX)=\alpha_t(X)$ for every $t,X$. No sheaf condition or isomorphism after sheafification is asserted. The universal units and their factorization equations determine these objects and maps up to compatible isomorphism.

proof.text: Construct each B_t explicitly as Mathlib leftKanExtension of the underlying abelian stage pullback sheaf along V_t.op, and beta_t as leftKanExtensionUnit. Use V.w to transport theta_b followed by beta_tprime to the restriction along V_t.op, and define the transition by descOfIsLeftKanExtension. First prove the identity and composition equations for theta as sheaf morphisms: apply injectivity of the stage adjunction homEquiv, use htheta at objects of F(i), and transport along F.map_id, F.map_comp and Under.w. Next use the Kan factorization equations and Arrow equality under precomposition and postcomposition to transfer these two equations to the transitions B.map. Kan hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension proves map_id and map_comp. The factorization equation gives exactly the required Arrow equation for beta and B.map.

Define delta_t explicitly by descOfIsLeftKanExtension applied to alpha_t.hom; descOfIsLeftKanExtension_fac_app gives its component factorization. For b from t to tprime, beta_t followed by B.map b and delta_tprime is a map between underlying sheaves. Regard it as a sheaf morphism and compare it with alpha_t using injectivity of the stage adjunction homEquiv. After precomposing with the stage unit, the B.map factorization, htheta, the delta_tprime factorization and halpha identify both maps with the original cocone unit. Transport endpoints with V.w, F.map_comp and Under.w; Arrow equalities can be precomposed, and postcomposed with components of a natural transformation at equal source-category objects. Thus these two sheaf morphisms agree. Kan hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension then gives B.map b followed by delta_tprime equals delta_t, proving naturality of gamma. Set gamma.app to delta; its factorization is the existing Kan lift equation. No sheaf condition or sheafification comparison is used.

theorem colimit_site_raw_abelian_section_diagram
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                    (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
                      (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X))))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
 :
    ∃ (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
      (β : ∀ t : Under i,
        ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
      (γ : B ⟶ (Functor.const (Under i)).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj),
      (∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t)) ∧
      (∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
        Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
          (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
        Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
          (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X)))) ∧
      (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj t.right),
        (β t).app (op X) ≫
          (γ.app t).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X)) =
        (α t).hom.app (op X))
